description: Na₃Cr₂P₃S₁₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four S atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.90-3.18 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four S atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.88-3.09 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five S atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.97-3.08 Å. There are two inequivalent Cr sites. In the first Cr site, Cr is bonded to six S atoms to form CrS₆ octahedra that share  an edgeedge with one CrS₆ octahedra and edges with three PS₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Cr-S bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.46 Å. In the second Cr site, Cr is bonded to six S atoms to form CrS₆ octahedra that share  an edgeedge with one CrS₆ octahedra and edges with three PS₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Cr-S bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.48 Å. There are three inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four S atoms to form PS₄ tetrahedra that share edges with two CrS₆ octahedra. There are a spread of P-S bond distances ranging from 2.01-2.11 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four S atoms to form PS₄ tetrahedra that share edges with two CrS₆ octahedra. There are a spread of P-S bond distances ranging from 2.04-2.07 Å. In the third P site, P is bonded to four S atoms to form PS₄ tetrahedra that share edges with two CrS₆ octahedra. There are a spread of P-S bond distances ranging from 1.99-2.12 Å. There are twelve inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded to two Na, one Cr, and one P atom to form edge-sharing SNa₂CrP trigonal pyramids. In the second S site, S is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Cr, and one P atom. In the third S site, S is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one P atom. In the fourth S site, S is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to two Cr and one P atom. In the fifth S site, S is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na, one Cr, and one P atom. In the sixth S site, S is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Cr and one P atom. In the seventh S site, S is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to two Na and one P atom. In the eighth S site, S is bonded to two Na, one Cr, and one P atom to form edge-sharing SNa₂CrP trigonal pyramids. In the ninth S site, S is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Cr, and one P atom. In the tenth S site, S is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na, one Cr, and one P atom. In the eleventh S site, S is bonded in an L-shaped geometry to one Cr and one P atom. In the twelfth S site, S is bonded in an L-shaped geometry to one Cr and one P atom.
